title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-sj6v: dead code in no-PIV response path
description: In protect_response(), the else branch (no-PIV response path) calls OscoreSeqNum::from_piv(request_piv) on line 970 which succeeds, then on lines 975-976 checks if request_piv.is_empty() or request_piv.len() > PIV_MAX_LEN. Both conditions are already validated by from_piv (seqnum.rs:117 rejects empty and len>5). This is unreachable dead code. Remove the redundant bounds check.
